Reproducible rational coefficient checks (3<=q<=36) and independent LPs (3<=q<=16) corroborate but are not extrapolated to infinity.

value.rationale: A motivated full metric classification of the first new rectangular width (three rows) for normalized Monge polytopes with recently established volume and facet theory. It uncovers a period-three incenter dimension jump and classifies the tangent-facet transitions for every column count; these are neither routine outputs of two-row parity nor square matrix formulas. A genuinely two-layer dual certificate is needed.
